entries.name: Python
entries.description: Select a Python version per project; useful when scripts and applications need different runtimes.
entries.notes: Registry key: python. Example: mise use python@3.13 (writes project configuration and may install Python). Platform availability depends on the selected version and backend.

entries.name: Project environment
entries.description: Give project commands a shared environment variable without changing the shell globally.
entries.notes: Requires mise and a POSIX shell. No additional tools or secrets are needed.

entries.name: Task dependencies
entries.description: Run a preparation task before a report task; replace the small commands with your own workflow.
entries.notes: Requires mise and a POSIX shell. The preparation message runs before the report message.

entries.name: mise-action
entries.description: Use project tool versions in GitHub Actions with the official mise setup action.
entries.notes: Follow upstream usage and runner requirements; this is an integration, not a tool to install through mise.

entries.name: Getting started
entries.description: Install mise, configure your shell, and learn the basic project workflow.
entries.notes: Official guide; use the registry for the complete tool inventory.
